bio: Nestled in the Somerset Mendips, Charlton House Hotel & Spa is a charming country house hotel and spa offering a traditional Afternoon Tea. Warm up with tea and cakes in this cosy hotel after exploring the Somerset countryside.  Take Afternoon Tea in the Lounge or the Restaurant. Featuring a refined yet rustic country decor, the dining areas are a quaint place to enjoy a classic British delicacy such as Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea includes a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, homemade scones served with Mendip clotted cream & Bay Tree strawberry jam, an array of cakes and your choice of teas and coffee. If you're celebrating something special, or just want to treat yourself, why not add a glass of Champagne or Prosecco to your Afternoon Tea?  Charlton House & Spa is a Bannatyne hotel situated in Somerset. The nearest station is Castle Cary.
